annotations.title: Advisor firm changes as registration dates

description: Advisors who left one firm and registered at another, from IAPD registration dates: the person, from and to firms with class, the end and begin dates, the gap and the move type; with a firm, by branch state. Bulk re-registrations are excluded unless asked for. Without a paid plan on a vertical, lists name their first 5 rows and count the rest; each answer states what it withheld.

advisor_dfx_id.description: An RIA graph advisor id of the form dfx:ria:<uuid>, or the individual CRD number.

cursor.description: The next_cursor value from the previous page of this tool, unchanged.

from_dfx_id.description: A DFX id of the form dfx:<graph>:<id>.

since.description: ISO date; registration ended on or after.

state.description: Two-letter US state code (USPS, DC and territories included). Needs from_dfx_id or to_dfx_id: the advisor's branch at the destination firm (moves in) or, with only from_dfx_id, at the origin firm (moves out) decides.

to_dfx_id.description: A DFX id of the form dfx:<graph>:<id>.

name: search_ria_advisor_moves
